name: Coi Trau Kham Trai - Mieng Trau Mo Loi

assets.purpose: Opening cover artwork with soft-octagonal lacquer caddy lid, inlay border, blank medallion, betel arcs, and restrained areca cluster.
Top-down interior tray artwork with four shallow compartments, blank central ivory insert zone, rim inlay, and sparse botanical details.
Isolated asymmetric betel vine ornament for section edges and vertical framing.
Isolated areca blossom and fruit spray for accents and ceremonial details.
Thin mother-of-pearl divider derived from the betel and areca motif family.
